# Test: grove add requires --detach for refs that are not branches
setup_workspace

exec git tag v1.0.0
! exec grove add v1.0.0
stderr 'ref "v1\.0\.0" is not a branch; use --detach to check it out detached'
! exists ../v1.0.0

! exec grove add --base main v1.0.0
stderr 'ref "v1\.0\.0" is not a branch; use --detach to check it out detached'

cp $WORK/second-readme README.md
exec git add README.md
exec git commit -m second
! exec grove add 'HEAD~1'
stderr 'ref "HEAD~1" is not a branch; use --detach to check it out detached'

exec sh -c 'GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="2000-01-01T00:00:00Z" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="2000-01-01T00:00:00Z" git commit-tree 4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904 -m "fixed commit"'
stdout '^cf201305887423c2fc295777c22e063dfc43449a$'
! exec grove add cf201305887423c2fc295777c22e063dfc43449a
stderr 'ref "cf201305887423c2fc295777c22e063dfc43449a" is not a branch; use --detach to check it out detached'

-- second-readme --
# Test
second
